title: CMS_encrypt mislabels AES CFB1/CFB8
claim: CMS_encrypt accepts AES-CFB1 and AES-CFB8, records the AES-CFB128 OID, then CMS_decrypt reports success but returns bytes that differ from the plaintext.
notes: Issue was open, had no comments, and showed no linked pull request when checked on 2026-11-05.
The report contains LLM-generated root-cause and fix sections; this case uses only its reproducer and independently checks observed behavior.
This is a correctness/API behavior report, not a newly discovered security vulnerability.
